title: Nobody Asked for a Crab Chair
summary: An article criticizing or discussing an unconventional mobility chair designed to resemble a crab, questioning whether such a design solves a real user need or is merely a novelty concept in assistive mobility technology.
problem_solved: Provides mobility assistance for individuals with limited movement capabilities
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of user-centered design in assistive technology and questions whether flashy designs prioritize aesthetics over practical functionality
